_comment: The part of the package that is written by hand: what each of the four systems is called in Chimera, which of Mednafen's ports belongs to which player, the names of the controls where Mednafen's own would collide or carry signs a movie cannot hold, and the settings a project may set, with what a user reads about each. Everything else - which devices a port takes, every button and axis of each, a setting's type, default, limits and choices - is read from Mednafen's own tables (run-native --describe) by gen-config.py, which stops when something here names a thing Mednafen does not have.

keys.P1 Up: Up, J1 POV1U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
keys.P1 Down: Down, J1 POV1D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
keys.P1 Left: Left, J1 POV1L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
keys.P1 Right: Right, J1 POV1R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight

portSetting.description: What is plugged into port %d. Ports 1 and 2 are the console's own when no multitap is plugged in. With a multitap in the first socket, ports 1 to 6 are on it and the next port is the second socket. 'none' leaves the port empty. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: ss.region_autodetect
settings.description: Takes the console's region from the game's disc. Turn it off to use the region set below, for a disc that names several regions or the wrong one. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: ss.region_default
settings.description: The console's region when it is not taken from the game: jp is Japan, na North America, eu Europe, kr Korea, tw Taiwan, as Asia, br Brazil, la Latin America. Japan and Taiwan use the Japanese BIOS file and the others the North American and European one. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: ss.cart
settings.description: What is in the cartridge slot. 'auto' picks what the game is known to need and the backup memory cartridge otherwise. 'backup' is a memory cartridge for saves, 'extram1' and 'extram4' are the 1 MB and 4 MB RAM cartridges some games require, 'cs1ram16' is a 16 MB RAM cartridge for homebrew, and 'ar4mp' is the Action Replay 4M Plus, which needs its own ROM file. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: ss.cart.auto_default
settings.display: Cartridge When The Game Needs None
settings.description: The cartridge that 'auto' plugs in for a game that is not known to need one. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: ss.input.sport1.multitap
settings.description: Plugs a six-player multitap into the console's first controller socket. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: ss.input.sport2.multitap
settings.description: Plugs a six-player multitap into the console's second controller socket. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: ss.smpc.autortc
settings.description: Sets the console's clock and language when the machine starts, so the BIOS does not stop to ask for them. The time is the Starting Clock setting. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: ss.smpc.autortc.lang
settings.description: The language the console is set to when the clock is set at start. Games read it to choose their own language. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: ss.h_overscan
settings.description: Shows the strips at the left and right edges of the picture that a television hid. It changes the picture only.

settings.name: ss.h_blend
settings.description: Blurs each line a little from left to right, as a television did. Some games rely on it to mix colours. It changes the picture only.

settings.name: ss.correct_aspect
settings.description: Shows the picture in the shape it had on a television. Turn it off to show the pixels as squares. It changes the picture only.

settings.name: ss.slstart
settings.description: The first line of the picture that is shown on an NTSC console. It changes the picture only.

settings.name: ss.slend
settings.description: The last line of the picture that is shown on an NTSC console. It changes the picture only.

settings.name: ss.slstartp
settings.description: The first line of the picture that is shown on a PAL console. It changes the picture only.

settings.name: ss.slendp
settings.description: The last line of the picture that is shown on a PAL console. It changes the picture only.

keys.P1 Left Pad Up: Up, J1 POV1U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
keys.P1 Left Pad Down: Down, J1 POV1D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
keys.P1 Left Pad Left: Left, J1 POV1L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
keys.P1 Left Pad Right: Right, J1 POV1R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight

settings.name: vb.cpu_emulation
settings.description: How closely the processor's timing is followed. 'accurate' counts every step and a few games need it. 'fast' is Mednafen's default. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: vb.input.instant_read_hack
settings.description: Gives the game the pad's buttons at the moment it asks for them and not after the console's real delay of a frame. It is Mednafen's default. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: vb.instant_display_hack
settings.description: Shows a frame as soon as it is drawn and not when the console's displays would light it. It changes which frame a picture belongs to, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: vb.3dmode
settings.display: How The Two Eyes Are Shown
settings.description: The console shows a picture to each eye. 'anaglyph' puts both on one picture in two colours for coloured glasses, 'sidebyside' puts them next to each other, 'cscope' is the layout of a CyberScope viewer, 'vli' and 'hli' weave them line by line, and 'left' and 'right' show one eye only. It changes the picture only.

settings.name: vb.anaglyph.preset
settings.description: The two colours of the 'anaglyph' picture, named after the glasses they suit. It changes the picture only.

settings.name: vb.3dreverse
settings.description: Gives the left eye's picture to the right eye and the right eye's to the left. It changes the picture only.

settings.name: vb.disable_parallax
settings.description: Draws both eyes' pictures the same, with no depth. It changes the picture only.

settings.name: vb.sidebyside.separation
settings.description: The number of empty pixels between the two pictures of the 'sidebyside' layout. It changes the picture only.

keys.P1 Up: Up, J1 POV1U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
keys.P1 Down: Down, J1 POV1D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
keys.P1 Left: Left, J1 POV1L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
keys.P1 Right: Right, J1 POV1R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight

portSetting.description: What is plugged into port %d. Ports 1 and 2 are the console's own. Ports 3, 4 and 5 are the extra ones of a multitap in the first socket, and ports 6, 7 and 8 those of one in the second. 'none' leaves the port empty. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: pcfx.input.port1.multitap
settings.description: Plugs a multitap into the console's first controller socket. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: pcfx.input.port2.multitap
settings.description: Plugs a multitap into the console's second controller socket. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: pcfx.cpu_emulation
settings.description: How closely the processor's timing is followed. 'accurate' counts every step, 'fast' does not, and 'auto' uses 'accurate' for the games known to need it. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: pcfx.cdspeed
settings.description: How many times faster than the real drive the disc is read. 2 is the console's own speed. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: pcfx.adpcm.emulate_buggy_codec
settings.description: Plays compressed sound the way the faulty tool some games were made with expected it. Mednafen says it is not accurate, only better for those games. It changes the sound, so a movie's recording needs the same value.

settings.name: pcfx.adpcm.suppress_channel_reset_clicks
settings.description: Removes the clicks heard when a game resets a sound channel. It changes the sound, so a movie's recording needs the same value.

settings.name: pcfx.nospritelimit
settings.description: Draws more than the console's 16 sprites on a line. It removes flicker and can show things a game meant to hide. It changes the picture only.

settings.name: pcfx.high_dotclock_width
settings.description: How many pixels wide the picture is handed out in the console's highest horizontal resolution: 341 is the real number of pixels, 256 loses detail, 1024 keeps every mode the same width. It changes the picture only.

settings.name: pcfx.rainbow.chromaip
settings.description: Smooths the colour of the console's video playback between pixels. It changes the picture only.

settings.name: pcfx.slstart
settings.description: The first line of the picture that is shown. It changes the picture only.

settings.name: pcfx.slend
settings.description: The last line of the picture that is shown. It changes the picture only.

keys.P1 Up: Up, J1 POV1U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
keys.P1 Down: Down, J1 POV1D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
keys.P1 Left: Left, J1 POV1L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
keys.P1 Right: Right, J1 POV1R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight

settings.name: lynx.rotateinput
settings.display: Turn The Pad With The Screen
settings.description: Some games are played with the console held upright. This turns the direction pad with the picture, so Up is still up. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.

settings.name: lynx.lowpass
settings.description: Passes the sound through a filter like the console's small speaker. It changes the sound, so a movie's recording needs the same value.

firmware.description: The PC-FX's BIOS (1 MB). The console starts from it. It is usually named pcfx.rom; versions 1.00 and 1.01 both work. It is NEC's and you have to supply it.
firmware.name: pcfx.rom

firmware.description: The Lynx's boot ROM (512 bytes). The console starts from it and it checks the cartridge. It is Atari's and you have to supply it.
firmware.name: lynxboot.img

firmware.description: The ROM of the Action Replay 4M Plus cartridge. It is needed when the Cartridge setting is 'ar4mp'. You have to supply it.
firmware.name: satar4mp.bin

commonSettings.name: initialTime
commonSettings.description: What the machine's clock shows when it is switched on, in seconds since 1970 (Unix time). The Saturn's clock is set from it. This is a setting, and not your computer's clock, so that a movie plays back the same on any day.
